newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen rangebound, profit-taking expected.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen rangebound, profit-taking expected.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to move within a range on Wednesday after notching up hefty gains over the last five sessions, with profit-taking seen hitting property stocks, brokers said.
"I believe the market will be rangebound with light profit-taking since U.S. stocks were a bit volatile overnight," said Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities.

The Hang Seng Index rose 180.00 points to 13,579.34 on Tuesday, bringing the gains over the past five sessions to 978.92 points, or 7.77 percent. The Hang Seng London Reference Index added another 10.53 points to 13,589.87 on Tuesday.
"It's natural for the market to take a breather," said Li.
The broad market in the United States was mixed although the Dow industrials rose 10.83 points to close at another record high of 7,225.32.
Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities said the blue-chip index should remain in a 50 to 80 point range with buying interest in individual red chips and H shares.
"There are a number of H shares queuing up for listing and this should lift sentiment on the existing H shares," he added.
